prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Seal Your Pet Adoption Pledge", "Confirm your companion's traits and sign your official adoption bond before bringing them to your desktop workspace.", "Your pet is excited to join your desktop!", "Confirm desktop interaction preferences"]
1: ["Verify Photo Quality & Feature Recognition", "Ensure your pet photo has clear lighting so your 3D desktop companion renders accurately without glitches.", "Looks Great, Create Pet"]
2: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "Follow this quick guide to master hotkeys, tray hide settings, and direct interaction modes.", "Press Alt+P to show or hide pet anytime", "Start Desktop Companion"]
3: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Desktop Pet's Data", "Your companion's progress, items, and personalized settings are saved safely to your account cloud vault.", "Signing in prevents pet reset issues when switching devices or restarting.", "Automatic Cloud Vault & Anti-Reset Shield Active"]
4: ["Calibrating Graphics & Desktop Physics Engine", "We are calculating screen boundaries and rendering your pet's 3D animations.", "Preparing desktop overlay bounds..."]
5: ["Choose Your Companion's Desktop Playstyle", "Select whether you want an active desktop companion or a quiet background reading buddy.", "Playstyle options"]
6: ["You will hear a gentle chime once your pet appears on your desktop.", "Play completion chime when ready"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "Quick controls: Right-click your pet for settings menu, Double-click to chat, Drag to position anywhere.", "Use Alt+H anytime to instantly hide your pet during fullscreen tasks.", "Got It, Let's Play!"]
8: ["Tip: Use bright front-facing light and a clear view of your pet's face for best 3D accuracy.", "Clear single pet photos yield optimal 3D desktop models"]
9: ["Includes Free Desktop Toy Pack on Completion"]
